title: minthostachys andina
intro: Minthostachys andina, commonly known as Andean mint, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is native to the Andean region and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Minthostachys andina include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as relaxation, pain relief, and antiseptic properties.
